correctness.rationale: A complete Pappus 18-vertex 27-edge graph is independently reconstructed from the canonical LCF word. The 20652 augmented faces are checked against all 262144 subsets. All 10321 greedy pairs have a 120240-incidence acyclic reversed Hasse graph; critical cells are 9 in dimension five and 1 in six. Exact signed integer Morse differential is the zero 9x1 column; Hurewicz makes its only attaching map null. Unreduced mod2 ranks (17,136,626,1768,3038,2980,1447,281,27) independently yield only beta5=9 and beta6=1.

value.rationale: The Pappus graph is a canonical cubic symmetric girth-six Levi graph of a classical incidence configuration. Its first higher-independence complex is motivated by the existing topology program, yet its integral mixed-dimensional classification is not a routine consequence of known chordal results. The exact zero attaching map yields a meaningful wedge of nine five-spheres and one six-sphere, including torsion-freeness, not merely a small numerical rank.
